name: Jujhar Logistics Limited
about: Jujhar Logistics Limited provides car carriers logistics services in India. It engages in the transportation of motor vehicles by road on purpose-built trailers for original equipment manufacturers and logistics service providers. The company was formerly known as CDG Petchem Limited and changed its name to Jujhar Logistics Limited in April 2026. Jujhar Logistics Limited was founded in 1996 and is based in Ludhiana, India.
